Q: How do I remove an item from my order?
A: You can modify or remove items from your order free of charge within 2 hours of placing it, or any time before it's marked as 'Processing' in your account, whichever comes first. Log in to your Segni Electronics account, go to 'My Orders', select the order, and choose 'Edit Order'. Once an order has shipped, it can no longer be changed — you'll need to receive it and use our return process instead. For urgent changes, contact support at +251-XXX-XXX or via live chat and we'll do our best to catch it before it ships.

Q: What's the cancellation fee if I cancel early?
A: Cancelling an order is free of charge as long as it hasn't shipped yet — you'll get a full refund within 3-5 business days to your original payment method. If your order has already been packed and dispatched by our courier when you cancel, a 5% handling fee applies to cover return logistics. Pre-orders for upcoming devices can be cancelled free of charge any time before the device ships.

Q: How do I check my invoice?
A: You can view and download invoices for any order by logging in to your account, going to 'My Orders', and clicking 'View Invoice' next to the relevant order. Invoices are also automatically emailed to you within 24 hours of your order shipping. Business account holders can access a consolidated monthly invoice under 'Account Settings > Billing'. If you can't find an invoice, contact support@segnielectronics.com with your order number.

Q: What payment methods do you accept?
A: Segni Electronics accepts Telebirr, CBE Birr, and bank transfer for all orders. Cash on delivery is available for orders within Addis Ababa only. For customers ordering from abroad or paying in foreign currency, we accept Visa and Mastercard. Business accounts placing bulk orders can also request Net-30 invoicing — contact our sales team to set this up.

Q: In which cases can I ask for a refund?
A: You're eligible for a full refund if: the device arrives defective or 'dead on arrival' (report within 48 hours of delivery), the item doesn't match its listing, you were charged more than once for the same order, or you didn't receive your order within the promised delivery window. Unopened items in original packaging can also be returned within 7 days for any reason, though a 10% restocking fee applies if the box has been opened. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days back to your original payment method once we receive the returned item.

Q: How do I create a new account?

If you're a reseller or buy in bulk, you can apply for a free Business account under 'Account Type' during signup for wholesale pricing and Net-30 invoicing.

Q: How do I close my account?
A: To close your account, go to 'Account Settings > Privacy' and select 'Delete Account', or email support@segnielectronics.com from your registered email with 'Delete Account' as the subject. Deleting your account permanently removes your order history, saved addresses, and any store credit balance, so make sure to use any pending store credit first. Account deletion is processed within 48 hours and cannot be undone.

Q: How do I unsubscribe from your newsletter?
A: Our newsletter sends you deals on new arrivals, restocks, and seasonal sales — roughly twice a month, no spam. Q: How do I submit a new delivery address?
A: To add a shipping address, go to 'Account Settings > Addresses' and click 'Add New Address'. Fill in the recipient name, phone number, city/sub-city, and specific landmark or house number (this helps our Addis Ababa couriers a lot). You can save multiple addresses and pick one at checkout. If the form won't submit, make sure all required fields are filled and your phone number is in the format 09XXXXXXXX — if the problem continues, contact support with a screenshot of the error.

Q: How do I use a business account?
